title: RollingState
description: Compressed 'semantic memory' of the discussion, produced and updated by the Observer Agent every 30–60s (previous state + new chunk + latest metrics → updated state). It supplements, never replaces, the raw transcript. It must NOT contain final per-candidate scores — only observations and understanding. See design §14.4, §16, §47.

candidate_positions.description: Map of candidate_id -> short description of their stance.

recent_interactions.description: Recent notable interactions, e.g. 'A responded to B', 'C supported A'.

discussion_direction.description: Where the discussion is currently heading.

observations.description: Optional non-scoring behavioral observations, e.g. 'Candidate C has low participation so far'. Observations only — never final scores. See design §16.

observations: Candidate C has low participation so far
